title: Onboarding lens HUD asset pack and microcopy for first-run console
creator: Asha Natarajan
description: Deliver a compact HUD (heads-up display) asset pack + microcopy for the console first-run experience. Goals: 1) Provide a single, reusable Figma component set for the first-run checklist panel, empty states, and progressive tips overlay ("lens"). 2) Ship accessible color tokens, responsive artboards (320/768/1280 widths), localized microcopy variants (EN/FR/DE/JA), and static screenshots for docs and release notes. Deliverables: Figma library (components + tokens), PNG/Multi-res screenshots for documentation (3 sizes), a short motion spec GIF (optional low-motion version), copy deck with i18n keys, and a screenshot capture checklist for engineering/QA. Acceptance criteria: components match console design system tokens, AA contrast on all text, copy approved by PM, screenshots pass visual regression checklist, engineering has export-ready assets and naming conventions. Constraints: animations must degrade to a static state for Private installs with limited GPU; avoid large Lottie files. UX decisions to note: use progressive disclosure via a single persistent badge + ephemeral tooltip rather than step-by-step modal to reduce cognitive load; show progress as fraction (2/6) and in checklist compact view; empty-state hero illustrations should be abstract infrastructure metaphors (nodes, pathways), not literal server racks. Accessibility: focusable elements, keyboard dismissible tips, visible focus ring, narration-friendly alt text for illustrations. Measurement: instrument events via 'onboard.lens.open', 'onboard.checklist.complete', 'onboard.screenshot.taken' and include them in the artifacts doc. Engineering handoff: include export tokens, slice naming conventions, and a small README with instructions for placing the HUD into the Console layout slot.
